notes: יְשַׂמַּח → *maketh glad* heads on the complement, not the light verb (rule 44).
Both written articles go `unrepresented` (*money*, *all things*), and הַכֹּל's own *all* is the quantifier's word with *things* the supplied generic (rules 29, 31, 41).
The object marker אֵת has no English realization; the ASV writes the object bare (rule 16).
